# SEKHEM — The Pharaoh's Pentest Codex

> An open-source, static, searchable penetration-testing knowledge base:
> methodology, checklists, payloads and commands across 24 domains. No logins,
> no telemetry. Redesigned and maintained by Dev Ahmed Sabry; based on
> PentestingEverything by m14r41 (MIT © 2023 Madhurendra Kumar).

SEKHEM is a reading-first codex of offensive-security reference material. It
contains 124 documentation pages and 104 curated PDF references covering web,
API, cloud, mobile, network, Active Directory, OSINT and 18 further domains.
All content is static, free, and openly licensed.

## Start here

- [The Codex (overview)](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/overview): entry point to the full methodology
- [Learning paths](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/learning-paths): guided routes through the material
- [References library](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/references): all reference documents in one place
- [The Tomb (vault)](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/vault): 104 PDFs, each with a SHA-256 seal
- [The Scarab (checklist)](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/scarab): local-first WebApp & API assessments
- [Contributing](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/contributing): how to contribute

## Attack-surface domains

- [Web Application Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/web-application-pentesting): 53 docs, 43 PDFs — recon through OWASP Top 10 and reporting
- [API Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/api-pentesting): 4 docs, 14 PDFs — REST/GraphQL testing
- [Secure Code Review](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/secure-code-review): 12 docs, 3 PDFs — source-code security
- [Mobile Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/mobile-pentesting): 9 docs, 3 PDFs — Android and iOS
- [Thick Client Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/thick-client-pentesting): 5 docs, 1 PDF
- [Cloud Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/cloud-pentesting): 5 docs, 6 PDFs — AWS, Azure, GCP
- [Network Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/network-pentesting): 5 docs, 9 PDFs
- [Firewall Penetration](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/firewall-penetration): 2 docs, 1 PDF
- [Infrastructure Security](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/infrastructure-security): 1 doc, 3 PDFs
- [Active Directory Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/active-directory-pentesting): 1 doc, 6 PDFs
- [Container & Kubernetes Assessment](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/container-and-kubernetes-assessment): 1 doc, 1 PDF
- [IoT Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/iot-pentesting): 2 docs
- [Wi-Fi Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/wi-fi-pentesting): 2 docs, 2 PDFs
- [Blockchain Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/blockchain-pentesting): 2 docs
- [OSINT](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/osint): 1 doc, 6 PDFs
- [Phishing Assessment](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/phishing-assessment): 2 docs
- [Configuration Review](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/configuration-review): 2 docs
- [DevSecOps](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/devsecops): 2 docs, 3 PDFs
- [CI/CD Pentesting](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/ci-cd-pentesting): 2 docs, 1 PDF
- [Threat Modeling](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/threat-modeling): 1 doc, 1 PDF
- [Forensic](https://sabriigsxr.github.io/sekhem/forensic): 4 docs, 1 PDF
